verification_log.summary: Ubersuggest (United States) keyword and SERP data retrieved 2026-10-12. Microsoft FY2026 figures confirmed. Correction made: the draft credited the faster net income growth to operating leverage; the 10-K attributes much of it to OpenAI investment gains, and the post now says so. Microsoft chart added from the 10-K figures. Network opened 2026-10-12: five competitor pages read for each post (pages that blocked access were replaced by the next ranking page). Vendor pricing pages read directly and match. IMF WEO values for all six economies confirmed through the IMF data API (dataset WEO 9.0.0). CFA Institute wording on duties, coverage depth, and the Series 86 exemption confirmed. World Bank data confirmed to run through 2025. All cited links resolve; SEC and OECD block automated requests but the pages are valid. H3 expansion of 2026-10-12: every added sentence reviewed. No new figures. Product statements checked against vendor pages (Finviz Elite features, Koyfin Plus 10-year data); general statements on organic growth reporting, satellite accounts, and composite development indices worded so they hold without a specific figure.
verification_log.interlinking: 2026-10-18: body links rebuilt to the hub-and-spoke SOP (spoke to pillar, pillar to every spoke, sibling links). Linking sentences describe the linked post only and add no new factual claims.
